inset-block.$description: dimension used by the toaster component for the distance between the stack and the top or bottom edge of the viewport (spec 049 FR-014).

inset-inline.$description: dimension used by the toaster component for the distance between the stack and the end edge of the viewport (spec 049 FR-014).

gap.$description: dimension used by the toaster component for the gap between stacked toasts (spec 049 FR-014).
